title: POST msgid validator allows multiple @: article stored with malformed key
description: TRIGGER: A POST client sends an article with Message-ID containing multiple @ signs, e.g. <local@domain@extra>. BEHAVIOR: reader/src/post/validate_headers.rs is_valid_message_id uses splitn(2, '@') so it sees local='local' and domain='domain@extra', both non-empty, and accepts the article. crates/core/src/validation.rs validate_message_id counts @ signs and rejects anything not exactly one. The accepted article flows into the pipeline with a msgid key that the transit ingestion path would reject at its stricter check, producing inconsistent storage or a pipeline abort after IPFS write already completed.
